title: The Enigma of the Aerofoil: Rival Theories in Aerodynamics, 1909–1930
author: David Bloor
note: Explanatory history of competing aerodynamic theories and research institutions, not a technical curriculum: eligible under H3. The comparative British/German account avoids T11; engineering explanation is central, so T12 is zero. Publisher contents, chapter abstract and specialist review excerpts support the mechanism-oriented interpretation. No high-confidence foundation-level criticism sufficient for V9 was established; this is not a full literature review.
notes: Participant reports, correspondence and committee records support the history.
Connects mathematical traditions, research organizations and engineering practice.
Useful for understanding resistance to models and relations between theory and application.
Traces rival lift explanations and their reception.
